kaṇṇikā.p: [Kaṇṇa+ṇika+ā] (thī) CL=7 (1) Ornaments of ears. Lotus cap. Lotus earrings. (3) Garland (or) Wreath. A   bunch of flowers. Kaṇṇikā(thī) [ka+nī+ṇvu+ā. Ke sīse nayatīti kaṇṇikā, ṇvu, ittaṃ, ṇattañca. Dhāna, ṭī. 219.] (1) Pinnacle. Center (or) Hub. (2) A combination. A bunch. A cluster. A hand (of banana). A wreath decorates the head (around the ear). (4) A yellow silk cotton flower.
